text: 招商证券首席策略分析师李昊阳表示，近期逆周期稳市举措陆续出台，从跨市场流动性风险阻断、产业资本激励、指数资金入市、交易制度配套四个维度协同发力，政策落地节奏紧凑、工具定位清晰，逐步打破前期的负面反馈螺旋，持续修复投资者风险偏好，为市场平稳运行构建起多层次、可联动的稳定框架。整体来看，配套机制打通了流动性投放、资金使用、资产承接的全链条，将短期流动性托底与资本市场基础制度建设有机结合，让稳市工具从单点发力走向闭环联动，持续巩固政策成效，为A股估值回归合理区间营造稳定的市场环境。（人民财讯）
text_en: Li Haoyang, Chief Strategy Analyst at China Merchants Securities, said that recent countercyclical market-stabilization measures have been introduced one after another, working in concert across four dimensions: blocking cross-market liquidity risks, incentivizing industrial capital, channeling index funds into the market, and supporting trading-system arrangements. The policies have been rolled out at a tight pace with clear tool positioning, gradually breaking the earlier negative feedback loop, continuously repairing investor risk appetite, and building a multi-tiered, interconnected stability framework for smooth market operation. Overall, the supporting mechanisms connect the entire chain of liquidity injection, fund use and asset absorption, organically combining short-term liquidity support with the building of capital market foundational systems, enabling stabilization tools to move from isolated efforts to closed-loop coordination, continuously consolidating policy results, and creating a stable market environment for A-share valuations to return to a reasonable range. (People's Financial News)
